post.description: Settles what a deriver computed from staleDerivations: each item a value, or a failure, with the hash it pulled. Values are written instance by instance through applyDerived, each instance in one event; an item whose hash moved, whose instance is gone, whose field was overridden or left its states, whose value the type refuses, or that another behavior vetoes is skipped, and the others still settle. A failure, an invalid value or a veto counts an attempt and appends no event. An item given twice, or with both a value and a failure, refuses the whole call. Needs the config's permission.
